note: Powder Bowl, Breakover, Shot Six and Felsen are named on the map in orange with no symbol: they keep OpenStreetMap's rating. The Alpental Back Bowls have 'no designated trails or runs' (beacon, shovel, probe and partner required, per the map), so OpenStreetMap's named lines there (Brownie Bowl, Hoadleys, Pumpkin Patch, Upper Snake Dance, What's That Trees, Bluffs, Chicken Shot, High Traverse, Homework, Shot 4, Shot 5, Alpental Goat Trail) are not on the resort's list and are hidden unless they link listed runs. Lower Return to Lifts is the map's 'Return Route from Back Bowls' (orange line, no symbol), kept at OpenStreetMap's blue.
